offering_description.value: Makes and sells paint protection film, window films, ceramic coatings and related products for vehicles, plus some architectural and marine uses. Sells through a network of independent installers and dealerships, and also installs some products itself. Films are made by contract manufacturers and cut with proprietary design software.

primary_products.value: paint protection film; automotive window film; ceramic coatings; architectural and marine films; film-cutting software

primary_services.value: film installation; installer training; vehicle protection application at company-owned locations

customer_segment.value: B2B: independent installers, auto dealerships, body shops, distributors; B2C: vehicle owners buying installed protection through installers and company-owned shops

end_markets.value: automotive aftermarket; automotive dealerships; architectural; marine; consumer electronics

revenue_model.value: product sales: films, coatings and software sold to installers and distributors; service fees: installation services at company-owned locations and related services

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs films and coatings made by contract manufacturers, sold to installers and distributors; service provider: installs products at company-owned shops for vehicle owners

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Middle East, Latin America and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: paint protection film, window film, coatings and software for vehicle protection

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent installers, auto dealerships and distributors; direct sales: direct sales to large accounts and installers; own locations: company-owned installation shops
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: product safety, chemical and VOC rules, window tint laws, and import tariffs and customs rules

notes: Scale of company-owned installation operations is uncertain.
